subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression?
rationale: The source-level bug and fix shape are clear, but the currently linked implementation path is outside the main repository, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not open a competing fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Close or adopt the fork fix, then allow a narrow replacement
options.body: Recommended: either pull the focused change into a maintainer-controlled branch or close the fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against current main.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and provide a mergeable upstream PR.

options.title: Do nothing until broader heartbeat work lands
options.body: Keep this issue open but accept that the documented custom-prompt regression remains in current main and v2026.6.11.

recommendation.title: Close or adopt the fork fix, then allow a narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Recommended: either pull the focused change into a maintainer-controlled branch or close the fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against current main.
